thread:
morgan_pm: Heads-up: we're finalizing GA acceptance for PredictEmbed. Need to confirm: SLA numbers, public vs internal docs, support coverage, monitoring alerts, pricing bands, and roll-out cadence. Quick volunteers? :wave:

sasha_eng: I can own SLA and monitoring. Proposal: SLO p50 < 60ms, p95 < 210ms, error-rate < 0.1%. Alert thresholds: p95>250ms for 10m, errors>0.2% for 5m. We'll implement fallback routing to smaller model at >400ms.

nina_support: Support coverage: Tier1 trained on common embedding errors + rate-limit questions. We'll need a troubleshooting matrix in docs with quick fixes. Oncall rotation: ml-support for first 14 days then hand off to backend-sre for second line.

tom_finops: Suggest PLG-friendly pricing: 15k tokens/day free for first 14 days, then tiered. Need infra to provide cost-per-1000 tokens. Will propose committed discounts for Dedicated later.

jenna_docs: Docs scope: public quickstart (Python/JS), API reference, SLA summary, migration notes for quantized models, troubleshooting runbook, and a known-limitations section (embedding drift). I'll draft.

anya_releases: Rollout: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% across two weeks. Automated smoke tests + canary gating. I'll own rollout.

infra-bot: Note: need to provision dedicated inference pools for canary traffic. Infra ticket #INF-2210 created.

morgan_pm: Quick decisions we need now: 1) Lock SLA numbers? 2) Public SLO vs full SLA doc? 3) Feature-flag default for quantized fallback?

sasha_eng: Locking SLOs as proposed. Public SLO summary only; enterprise SLA with credits handled separately. For feature flag: default allow fallback, opt-out header X-Prefer-Exact: true.

nina_support: Agrees. We'll prepare escalation steps and include example logs for common errors.

jenna_docs: Anything else for docs? I'm missing sample SDK responses for edge cases. Sasha can you drop sample error payloads?

sasha_eng: Dropping sample errors: `{ "error": "rate_limit_exceeded", "retry_after": 60 }` and `{ "error": "model_fallback", "note": "returned smaller-dim vectors" }`.

morgan_pm: Action list: Sasha: finalize monitoring queries + sample errors (24h). Jenna: initial docs PR + SLA summary (48h). Tom: provisional pricing (72h). Anya: canary automation (5 days). Nina: support runbook (48h). Infra-bot: provision pools (done).

infra-bot: Pools created for canary, ticket updated INF-2210.

morgan_pm: Great. Locking numbers for planning. I'll create GA checklist card and tag owners. Thanks!
